fact: The ACI reports that the government, with UNDP support, held a national workshop on 6-7 May 2026 in Brazzaville launching the drafting of the national AI strategy, whose final document is still to be written.
Minister Frederic Nze chaired the launch in Brazzaville of the technical committee drafting the national AI strategy, supported by UNDP, with six months to produce eleven deliverables.
Minister Leon Juste Ibombo announced at the 12 January 2026 Arpce seminar that a national AI strategy is being drawn up with the African Centre for AI Research and UNDP.
